paper: A Benchmark Dataset for MLLM-Generated Image Detection: GPT Image2 & Nano Banana2
evaluation_note: OriginScope reports group-held-out development metrics; real/GPT/Nano variants of the same matched scene remain in the same fold. These are not claimed as universal benchmark accuracy.
dataset_card_note: The upstream Hugging Face dataset card currently lists 4,356 rows and 3.32 GB; the repository may change over time.
